Map export for ▾ ⚠ Caution, experimental!
Generate trim maps or CSV from lambda data. For IAW16M, only a simulated fuel-map correction is available; ECU BIN export remains disabled.
Measurement confidence
Applies to all formats (PVM, DJM preview, MPP, CSV and IAW16M preview). Only measured samples assigned directly to a cell count. Cells below the threshold retain the original value (or 0% correction). Gap filling never overrides this protection.
IAW16M · Source BIN
Choose an original .bin (64 KiB) or a ZIP containing one BIN. For compatible IAW16M dumps, map position, RPM axis, TPS raw values and Delta Fuel are checked. With a lambda log loaded, the calculated Base Fuel correction is displayed. Download generates a new .bin and verifies all 65,536 bytes: only Base Fuel may change.
No BIN loaded yet.
TPS → degrees conversion
0 % and 100 % TPS in the MD-Lambda-View CSV correspond to the min and max angle of the injection map.
Correction parameters
Smoothing/outlier rejection happens at CSV import. Only cells with enough samples are corrected. The calculation limits changes to MAX_CHANGE. Monotony is applied only to measured cells within that limit. The original BIN stored in the browser is never changed; the download is a new copy.
Rapid Bike EVO · current map
Load the currently active Rapid Bike .mpp file. The file is read, the first map is recomputed from the lambda measurement (as additive RB units on top of the base inside it), the rest of the file stays untouched. Returned as a new .mpp.
Fixed grid of the RB format (Ténéré 700):
40 RPM rows: 1400 – 11200 rpm (irregular)
8 TPS columns: 0 · 5 · 10 · 20 · 40 · 60 · 80 · 95 %
No MPP loaded yet.
Correction parameters
Calculation: deviation to target λ in %, divided by “% fuel per RB unit”, clamped to ± the max change, written additively (as integer) onto the base map. Column 0 % is left untouched (overrun). The target λ values come from the 2D app preset (see below: “Target λ per TPS zone”).
Custom template
Load a .pvm file from your PowerCommander software. For PVM, axes and the fuel map are detected dynamically. Export adds the calculated percentage correction to the existing primary fuel map, preserving the remaining data. If multiple separate primary maps are present, export remains disabled. For DJM, the vehicle identifier, axes and block layout are read for preview only; binary DJM export remains disabled for safety. The file stays in browser storage until you remove it.
No template loaded yet.
Target λ per TPS zone
TPS boundaries between zones
Linear interpolation between TPS values. These targets apply only to the export (2D, 3D and IAW16M flash); the 2D app has its own targets that stay untouched.
